summary: Orchestrator for named, interconnected Relations built on the shared Graph kernel. RelationDAG registers relations and sources, tracks dependency_edges separately from constraint_edges (foreign keys), and compiles targets via DAGMaterializationSession, with collect, collect_with_drift, execute, schema, validate, to_dot and to_package. DAGRelation is a type-preserving Relation bound to a DAG; the session caches canonical per-name results across backends and dialects.
key_classes: RelationDAG — registers named relations/sources, resolves refs, collects with cross-backend coercion
DAGRelation — Relation subclass returned by dag.ref()/dag.source(); terminals compile through dag.execute() without mutating the DAG
DAGMaterializationSession — per-run cache and resolver of canonical entries, coercion keys and ownership
RelationDAGProtocol — structural contract used by DAGRelation, validation and packaging
key_functions: RelationDAG.source(name, data) — register a source and return a DAGRelation
RelationDAG.bind(**sources) — produce an execution DAG with bound data
RelationDAG.collect(name, *, target=None) — compile and collect a named relation
RelationDAG.collect_with_drift(...) — collect plus conform drift report
RelationDAG.execute(relation, *, target=None) — compile an arbitrary relation against the DAG
RelationDAG.add_constraint(child, fk) — record a ForeignKey constraint edge
resource_to_relation(ref_or_resource) — build a Relation from a ResourceRef/DataResource
extension_points: validation_context / key_context hooks for DataPackage validation
